title: Machine Learning Engineer Roadmap
summary: A concise pathway from solid fundamentals to a job‑ready portfolio, focusing on core ML concepts, hands‑on projects, and deployment basics. Follow each phase to build confidence, showcase work, and prepare for hiring or freelancing.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Establish the mathematical and programming base needed for modern ML.

milestones.title: Python for Data Science
milestones.outcome: Write clean Python scripts for data loading, cleaning, and visualization.

tasks.title: Complete Python basics on freeCodeCamp
tasks.description: Work through the JavaScript‑free Python curriculum, focusing on functions and data structures.

tasks.title: Set up a virtual environment
tasks.description: Create and activate a virtualenv, install pandas, numpy, and matplotlib.

tasks.title: Practice list comprehensions
tasks.description: Rewrite a loop that filters a CSV column using list comprehensions.

tasks.title: Reflect on coding style
tasks.description: Write a short note on PEP 8 conventions you will follow.

milestones.title: Linear Algebra & Probability Refresher
milestones.outcome: Apply vector, matrix, and probability concepts to simple ML formulas.

tasks.title: Watch Khan Academy linear algebra series
tasks.description: Focus on matrix multiplication and eigenvalues relevant to ML.

tasks.title: Solve probability exercises on StatQuest
tasks.description: Complete three problems on conditional probability and Bayes' theorem.

tasks.title: Implement vector ops with NumPy
tasks.description: Code dot product, norm, and covariance calculations on a sample dataset.

tasks.title: Summarize key formulas
tasks.description: Create a one‑page cheat sheet of formulas you’ll reuse.

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.summary: Gain practical expertise with essential ML libraries and evaluation techniques.

milestones.title: scikit-learn Mastery
milestones.outcome: Build, tune, and evaluate classic models using scikit-learn.

tasks.title: Read scikit-learn user guide overview
tasks.description: Skim the official docs sections on estimators, pipelines, and model selection.

tasks.title: Implement a churn predictor
tasks.description: Use a public dataset to train a logistic regression, evaluate with ROC‑AUC.

tasks.title: Practice cross‑validation
tasks.description: Apply KFold to the churn model and record variance in scores.

tasks.title: Connect with a Kaggle community post
tasks.description: Ask a question about model bias and respond to another user’s query.

milestones.title: Deep Learning with PyTorch
milestones.outcome: Construct, train, and debug neural networks in PyTorch.

tasks.title: Follow PyTorch official tutorial 60‑minute blitz
tasks.description: Run each code cell, modify the loss function, and note changes.

tasks.title: Build a simple MLP for MNIST
tasks.description: Create a two‑layer network, train for 5 epochs, and log accuracy.

tasks.title: Practice gradient checking
tasks.description: Manually compute gradients for a tiny network and compare to autograd output.

tasks.title: Reflect on debugging steps
tasks.description: Write a brief log of common errors you encountered and fixes applied.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Create portfolio‑ready projects that demonstrate end‑to‑end ML pipelines.

milestones.title: Churn Prediction Project
milestones.outcome: Publish a write‑up and GitHub repo showing data prep, modeling, and evaluation.

tasks.title: Select a public churn dataset
tasks.description: Download from Kaggle and store in a clean CSV folder.

tasks.title: Document model pipeline
tasks.description: Write a markdown README describing steps, features, and metrics.

tasks.title: Create visual evaluation report
tasks.description: Generate ROC curve and confusion matrix plots with matplotlib.

tasks.title: Write a blog post summary
tasks.description: Explain business impact and model limitations in 800 words.

tasks.title: Share on LinkedIn
tasks.description: Post the repo link with a concise description and ask for feedback.

milestones.title: Image Classifier API
milestones.outcome: Deploy a PyTorch image classifier behind a REST API and document the process.

tasks.title: Choose a small image dataset
tasks.description: Use CIFAR‑10 subset and store images locally.

tasks.title: Wrap model with FastAPI
tasks.description: Create an endpoint that accepts an image and returns a class label.

tasks.title: Containerize with Docker
tasks.description: Write a Dockerfile, build the image, and run locally.

tasks.title: Test API with curl
tasks.description: Send sample requests and verify JSON responses.

tasks.title: Add monitoring stub
tasks.description: Log inference latency to a simple file for later dashboarding.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Round out expertise with MLOps basics, model evaluation depth, and job‑search preparation.

milestones.title: Model Evaluation Deep Dive
milestones.outcome: Select, compute, and interpret advanced metrics for classification and regression.

tasks.title: Read Model Evaluation chapter on MDN
tasks.description: Focus on precision, recall, F1, and calibration curves.

tasks.title: Implement calibration plot
tasks.description: Write code to plot predicted probability vs. observed frequency.

tasks.title: Practice error analysis
tasks.description: Identify top mis‑classified examples and hypothesize reasons.

tasks.title: Reflect on metric trade‑offs
tasks.description: Summarize when to prioritize recall over precision in a short note.

milestones.title: MLOps Basics
milestones.outcome: Set up a reproducible training pipeline with version control and simple CI.

tasks.title: Watch Google Cloud MLOps intro video
tasks.description: Take notes on CI/CD concepts specific to ML models.

tasks.title: Create a GitHub Actions workflow
tasks.description: Automate linting and unit tests for a small ML repo.

tasks.title: Practice model versioning with DVC
tasks.description: Track data and model files, then push to remote storage.

tasks.title: Connect with an MLOps forum
tasks.description: Join a discussion on best practices and share your pipeline link.

milestones.title: Job & Client Readiness
milestones.outcome: Craft targeted application materials and interview confidence.

tasks.title: Polish resume for ML roles
tasks.description: Highlight Python projects, libraries, and measurable outcomes.

tasks.title: Prepare STAR stories
tasks.description: Write three concise anecdotes covering impact, challenge, action, result.

tasks.title: Mock technical interview
tasks.description: Pair with a peer to solve a coding problem using Python in 45 minutes.

tasks.title: Reflect on feedback
tasks.description: Document strengths and improvement areas after the mock interview.
